title: Belgium at the Crossroads: Frozen Russian Assets and a Missed Climate… · 09 Sep
keywords: Belgium, Euroclear, frozen Russian assets, Ukraine funding, EU nature restoration law, climate governance, Belgian federal government, EU foreign policy, nature restoration plan, implementation gap, European Green Deal, Russian central bank assets
notes: Belgium finds itself at the centre of two of the European Union's most consequential policy debates simultaneously. The country holds effective veto power over nearly €185 billion in frozen Russian central bank assets while also failing to meet an EU nature-restoration deadline, raising uncomfortable questions about Belgium's willingness and capacity to deliver on its European commitments.
